variants.headline: The colony has voted
variants.body: An election to the Colonial Assembly has been held in {colony}. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: Ballots before the business of government
variants.body: The colony has held its election to the Colonial Assembly. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: An Assembly election enters the record
variants.body: Voting in an election to the Colonial Assembly has taken place. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.
